full_prompt_en: A square geometric editorial illustration arranges three large stylized faces and smaller animal forms in a tightly interlocked field of blue, rust red, mustard yellow, and cream. The upper background is pale blue, crossed by thin horizontal rules, small angular bird marks, and a broad golden disk at the upper right. Across the center, the faces overlap instead of occupying separate spaces. On the left, a long blue-and-cream profile has a striped dark hair cap, one enlarged eye, and a strong red angular nose. The central face is taller, with a dark striped crest above a half-lidded eye and a red nose projecting toward the right. Another pale blue face on the right turns slightly left, its eye beneath a red-brown cap-like shape and its mouth reduced to a short line. Black, navy, and orange contours divide the heads into flat rectangular and triangular planes. Near the lower center, a small yellow-and-blue horse-like head pushes through the overlapping figures, while another simplified animal form appears at the lower right. Repeated vertical stripes, stippled patches, and faint printlike grain give the clean color blocks a tactile finish. The design has little conventional depth; transparency, shared outlines, and crossing color bands imply relationships between shapes. Light is graphic and even, with contrast created by neighboring color areas rather than cast shadows. The surrounding cream and blue gaps keep the dense center legible, while the golden circle pulls the eye upward. The overall composition is playful and precisely balanced, combining folk-like symbols, cubist fragmentation, and crisp mid-century poster color into one continuous visual puzzle.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形几何编辑插画把三张大型风格化面孔和较小的动物形态紧密嵌合在蓝色、铁锈红、芥黄和乳白色的色场中。上方背景是浅蓝色，细水平线、小型棱角飞鸟标记和右上角宽大的金色圆盘横贯其间。中央几张脸互相重叠，而非分处独立空间。左侧一张蓝白相间的长侧脸戴条纹深色发帽，有一只放大的眼和突出的红色棱角鼻子。中央面孔较高，半闭的眼睛上方是深色条纹冠形，红鼻向右伸出。右边另一张浅蓝脸略朝左，眼睛位于红棕色帽状形体下，嘴被简化成短线。黑色、海军蓝和橙色轮廓把头部分割为平坦矩形与三角形色面。接近下方中央，一只黄蓝相间、近似马头的小形体从交叠人物间探出，右下还有另一个简化动物形态。重复竖条、点状色块和轻微印刷颗粒给干净色块增添可触摸的表面。设计几乎没有传统纵深；透明叠压、共用轮廓与交叉色带暗示形状之间的关系。光线是均匀的图形化处理，明暗对比来自相邻色面，而非投影。周围的乳白和蓝色间隙保持密集中央的可读性，金色圆形则牵引视线上行。整体构图活泼而精密均衡，把民俗般符号、立体主义式碎片和清爽的中世纪海报配色组合成连续的视觉谜题。
style_prompt_en: The graphic illustration uses flat, sharply bounded blocks of pale blue, deep navy, rust red, mustard yellow, and warm cream. Long horizontal rules intersect compact vertical stripes and diagonal wedges, establishing an intricate grid without relying on perspective. Forms share contours and partially overlap, so each color plane can read as both an independent unit and part of a larger mosaic. Enlarged simple curves interrupt the rectilinear structure and give the rhythm a playful lift. Fine stipple, small print misregistration, and dry grain soften otherwise crisp edges. Illumination remains flat and even; value shifts come from adjacent pigments rather than modeled shadows. Dense central clustering is balanced by quieter margins and a few large circular accents. The overall effect is witty, ordered, and tactile, with poster-like clarity despite the layered geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅图形插画采用边界锐利的平坦色块，包括浅蓝、深海军蓝、铁锈红、芥黄和暖乳白。长水平细线与紧凑竖条、斜向楔形相交，在不依赖透视的情况下建立复杂网格。形体共用轮廓并局部重叠，使每块颜色既能独立阅读，又属于更大的镶嵌整体。放大的简单曲线打断直线结构，让节奏轻快。细点、轻微套印错位和干颗粒软化原本清晰的边缘。照明保持平坦均匀；明度变化来自相邻色料，而非塑形阴影。中央密集聚合由安静的周边和少数大型圆形重音平衡。整体效果机智、有序且有触感，层叠几何之中仍保有海报般清楚的可读性。
theme_en: Three geometric faces and small animal forms beneath a golden sun
theme_zh: 金色太阳下的三张几何面孔与小动物形态
name: Ale Giorgini
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
